answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The dawn counter is kept in atlas and glacier shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Scaling to 381 identities multiplies that fee by 503 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
